thread:
maria: Quick kickoff — Q3 hosted API capacity planning thread. Need buy vs lease scenarios for Sep-Nov surge. Aim: 99.9% regional SLA, <180ms p50 latency on standard gen models, total token throughput +45% vs Q2. Please post assumptions and hard numbers. TL;DR: conservative / baseline / aggressive.
akshay: I'll run sim for fleet mixes today. Quick Q: do we include private dedicated uplift for enterprise customers in the same pool? If yes, we need 10% reserved.
tess: Yes include reserved 10% in baseline. Also APAC needs a 15% extra buffer due to regional growth.
luc: Initial sim: baseline = buy 30% fixed (40 A100s), lease 70% burst (on-demand + spot). Baseline capacity covers 3.1B tokens/day -> ~1.2M GPU-hours/month (est).
jamie: numbers sanity check — 1.2M GPU-hours sounds high. Break down for us: model mix, median seq, batching assumptions.
luc: breakdown paste:
```model_mix: 60% rlm, 30% chat, 10% embeddings
avg_seq: 120 tokens
batching_eff: 3.5x
est_tps_per_gpu: 45 tokens/sec
```
olivia: Cost calc rough: buy (amortized) $0.75/hr per A100; lease spot $1.10/hr; on-demand $2.8/hr. Baseline monthly cost delta vs Q2 ~ +$280k.
noa: Can we tighten APAC buffer by moving some routes to warm-cache lane? That would reduce required peak GPUs by ~8%.
akshay: Good call. I'll add caching policy + routing fallback in sim. Also consider mixed precision quantization for embeddings heavy routes — reduces usage by ~12%.
deploy-bot: Reminder: last purchase contract had 12-week lead time for delivery.
maria: Decision proposals:
- Conservative: buy 10% (10 A100s), lease rest, keep APAC buffer 20%
- Baseline (recommended): buy 30%, lease 60%, reserved 10% for enterprise
- Aggressive: buy 50%, lease 40%, preemptible mix for 25% of load
Please react with :thumbsup: for baseline or post objections.
akshay: :thumbsup: baseline from infra side, but push to reduce lease on-demand exposure—prefer longer-term leases to lower $/hr.
tess: Ops note — runway for ops headcount to support more buys is tight; more buys = more maintenance.
luc: I'll produce final cost/latency spreadsheet + failure-mode sims by EOD tomorrow.
maria: Great. Tagging finance for budget sign-off @jamie @olivia. We'll checkpoint Thurs 10am PT.
